question.text: A prospective LP wants the Manager of Kalindi AIF to explain how valuation deviations will be treated under SEBI rules. Per Annexure 12.1 / Ch 12, which SEBI circular governs the standardised valuation approach in AIFs?

answer.text: SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2023/97 dated June 21, 2023.

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 12 footnote 128 explicitly cites 'SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2023/97 dated June 21, 2023' as the standardised valuation approach for AIFs referenced in Annexure 12.1. The Trap: A, B, D are other SEBI regulations unrelated to AIF valuation standardisation. Note: The workbook also references a later modification circular (SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD-1/P/CIR/2024/123 dated September 19, 2024) to the valuation framework on pages 249 and 421; for the Ch 12/Annexure 12.1 footnote question, the June 21, 2023 circular is the keyed answer.
